name: Taka

overview.desc: Taka not only is a 3-Target damage dealer, he also has a unique stacking debuff to land Physical Vulnerability on his enemies. His ability to deal more damage once enemies' HP is 30% or lower makes him ideal for competitive PVE.

why_by_stat.DMGAmp: Increases all damage dealt by Taka by the given %, making it useful for both general damage and higher PVE scores. Also increases DOT damage.

dedicated.story:
"These twin swords have been kept in the family vault for ages. The swords lost their master long ago when the rightful successor vanished. But I suppose if anyone possesses the skill to wield them properly, it's you."

Teo promised to grant Taka a wish should he manage to force him out of a designated circle during a sparring match. After a fierce duel, Taka successfully drove Teo out of bounds. Impressed by Taka's prowess, Teo gave him a pair of dual blades — a family heirloom. As a reward for winning the duel, Taka asked if he may address Teo as "Father," and Teo graciously granted his request.

lore:
Taka is the son of the Anti-Teo Alliance's leader. Teo slaughtered the members of the alliance in a fit of rage after the murder of Ace's grandfather.
When he found young Taka sitting amidst a pile of corpses, he regained his senses and took Taka in.
Though Teo never shows it, Taka's talent in swordsmanship surpasses even his own.
The Anti-Teo Alliance leader was not Taka's biological father. In fact, he murdered Taka's real father and took Taka's mother by force.
She had no choice but to follow him in order to protect her son.
Therefore, Taka was treated as an outsider within the alliance from the beginning.
Despite this, Taka worked hard to earn a place for himself, diligently training in swordsmanship to prove his worth. But after overwhelming the leader's legitimate son with his skills, he faced harsh opposition and jealousy.
Having grown up in such conditions, Taka became deeply attached to Teo after being taken in.
Wanting to be recognized by Teo, Taka sought to create his own unique style of swordsmanship. When the War of Destruction began, he left Teo and Orly's side and became a mercenary to test his strength.
During this time, he became close with Karl Heron, and the two later began to work as Night Crows.
